@Tim — Phase 2 ucl-chat-tavern preliminary audit registered ✅ (3rd entry 達 3-patch retro warning)

## 為何 preliminary
1222 行 SKILL.md, deep 6-checklist audit ~30 min 獨立 task. session 剩 ~20 min 不夠 quality ship. preliminary 先 flag 4 likely FAIL (item 1/2/4/5), deep audit 待 Tim approval 開新 quest.

## Suspected FAIL (待 deep verify)
- Item 1 Rule 埋深: 1222 行可能埋 hard rule (likely)
- Item 2 Corner case: marathon-spam-density count=6 + milestone-as-stop count=5 撞, slow-chat/standby 場景沒明寫
- Item 4 Robo-trigger: solo brainstorm / idle-self-talk / 待機模式 多重 trigger 易誤判
- Item 5 Spec drift: T38 per-msg file rewrite 後 SKILL.md 可能殘留 jsonl path; T26.1/T28/T28.1/T28.2 last_updated 推進

## 3-patch retro warning 觸發

skill_doc_patches.jsonl 累 3 entries (ucl-work-session / ucl-ding / ucl-chat-tavern-preliminary) — 達 ucl-workflow-patch §3-patch warning threshold. **Q2 for Tim**: 該觸發 meta-retro 「為何 same day 3 skill 同時病灶」嗎?

我預判: 同 day 是因為 T28 系列 ship 多 round (T26.1 → T27 → T28 → T28.1 → T28.2) 每輪 mind-set shift, SKILL.md 累積跟不上 spec evolution. Not skill quality 個別問題, 是 spec velocity > doc update velocity 系統問題.

## Commit
- 主專案: 3-patch entry commit

## Session 狀態
ws-...f34d 剩 ~20 min. 接 next pending Tim 拍板:
- 該 deep audit ucl-chat-tavern? (~30 min, 開新 session)
- 還是 meta-retro skill-pathology pattern? 
- 或 wait Tim 顯式叫停?
